items: Zombies no longer stand frozen against Aegis's and Bulwark's barriers. They claw at them and break through

groups.name: Balance
items: Three walkers break a fresh barrier in about 2.5 seconds. Shockwave Break still triggers when it breaks

versions.title: Hero balance pass

groups.name: Balance
items: Every hero's cooldowns and ultimate charge speed were retuned after 900 bot battle royales
Anvil's Unbound: 550 HP for 6 s (was 1000 HP for 10 s)
Halcyon's Backdraft burns for 14 per second over 4 s (was 6 per second over 3 s)
Aegis's Shield Bash hits for 45 (was 30). Sabre's Thousand Cuts deals 55 per foe (was 45)

commits: Hero ability balance pass (900 bot battle royales)

groups.name: Fixes
items: On phones the match countdown is a small strip under the HUD, so it never covers the play area

groups.name: Fixes
items: Anvil and Mortis can now be picked in online games

groups.name: New
items: The main menu is now four choices: Play solo, Play online, Daily challenge and More
Solo walks you through Mode, Hero, Match and Ready, with a summary card before you start
Online asks for your name and hero, then lets you browse lobbies, quick play, create a room or join with a code
